en.name: Pius VI
en.summary: A pope whose defiance of the French Revolution led to his arrest by Napoleon's forces and death in captivity in France.
en.body: Giannangelo Braschi presided over the Papal States during the upheaval of the French Revolution, condemning the Civil Constitution of the Clergy that subordinated the French church to the revolutionary state. Napoleon's invading forces annexed papal territory and, in 1798, took Pius prisoner; he died in French custody at Valence the following year, the first pope in centuries to die in exile, a stark symbol of the Church's vulnerability in the revolutionary age.
